descripcion:
Welcome to Villa 5, an inviting 6-bedroom retreat nestled within Lirios Village Marbella villa compound, boasting an unbeatable location just a leisurely 7-minute walk from the vibrant Puerto Banus Marina. Hosting up to 18 guests, this charming escape features a flat garden ideal for children's play, a private HEATED pool, a poolside BBQ area, and a delightful outdoor seating space with a swing. Paired with Villa 4, this property offers abundant space for larger groups, all within easy reach of the bustling attractions and picturesque ambiance of Puerto Banus.

NEARBY AMENITIES and SECURITY
Located in the heart of Puerto Banus, this villa is an ideal choice if you prefer not to drive for dinner or for a drink, as the main strip is just a short walk away. A plethora of dining options awaits, from the upscale La Sala and Breathe restaurants to more casual spots like Mister Noodle, Burger Bar, or an Organic Juicery. SuperCor supermarket, hairdressers, and beauty salons are conveniently located nearby. Despite its central location, Villa 10 provides a peaceful and relaxing retreat for your well-deserved holiday. For added peace of mind, the villa is equipped with a 24/7 security alarm.

ENTERTAINMENT
Enjoy lightning-fast 5G optic fiber internet, relax to your favorite tunes using the Bluetooth audio speaker, binge-watch your favorites on Netflix, and soak up the sun by the inviting pool. I am sure you will have fun!

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
The villa's bedrooms are prepared with fresh linen and towels for guests. All bedrooms are thoughtfully decorated with new beds, soft duvets, comfortable pillows, and mattresses. 

There are 2 bedrooms on the ground floor: 1 en-suite twin bedroom and 1 triple bedroom (with one double and one single bed). Please ask about wheelchair accessibility before booking.

Upstairs, there are two en-suite triple bedrooms (with one double and one single bed), one double (with two single beds put together) and one triple bedroom (with three single beds).

For those who enjoy cooking, there is a recently refurbished and fully equipped kitchen with plenty of pots, pans, wine and champaigne glasses, crockery, utensils and cutlery for large groups of guests. Coffee lovers can enjoy their coffee from Dolce Gusto coffee machine. 

SERVICES
@Lirios Village Marbella, we offer a wide range of tailor-made services to ensure your stay is as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. We can arrange your airport transfers, include daily maid service, arrange groceries shopping, welcome surprise decoration, boat trips, and more. Maid service is included in high-season direct bookings, and it can be added to any other booking. We also offer airport transfers and private chef services.

MAID SERVICE
Direct bookings @liriosvillagemarbella for July and August include one complimentary maid service. The service can also be added to any booking made via online platforms or agents for 125 EUR/day, covering a light clean of the kitchen, living areas, bathrooms, and bedrooms. Fresh linen and towels are available for an additional 130 EUR laundry fee. Make it a holiday for everyone! :-)

AIRPORT TRANSFERS
We are happy to arrange airport transfer for your group. We usualy wait for our guests in the arrival hall and take them directly to the villa or make a short supermarket stop on the way. Our fare is 17 EUR/person and a minimum 170 EUR fare per transfer applies.

POOL HEATING
Pool heating is available at 90 EUR/day (min. 270 EUR).

PRIVATE CHEF
We proudly offer services of our professional private chef who can come to the villa with waiters and prepare a special or traditional Spanish lunch, dinner or BBQ. He can even provide half or full-board - check @chefivanduranmiguel and @liriosvillagemarbella to see photos and rates of the amazing things he is able to prepare. His special menu options start from 50 EUR/person.

Even though this villa is completely independent and offers ultimate privacy, the proximity of four other 6-8 bedroom villas with their private pools and gardens allows us to accommodate up to 90 guests in the same area.

MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY UP TO 18 GUESTS
Even though this villa sleeps up to 16 guests comfortaby, additional 2 beds could be installed in the largest bedrooms for 2 extra guests. There is plenty of space but you must consider if privacy is an issue for you.

PARKING
You can safely park up to 3 cars in a roofed parking space behind the property gates. There is unlimited parking in a parking lot 150 meters from the property.
